_comment: The featured startup shown at the top of the list. Written by the /feature slash command, read by featured.js in the browser. `current` is what renders; `history` is the ledger that stops a company being featured twice. Set current to null to show nothing.

current.blurb: An IDE for biology: agents that move data between the tools a lab already uses, so a scientist can upload a protein's composition and ask for its predicted shape in one place. Grew out of an open-source agent now used by 4,300 organizations, including 18 of the 20 largest pharma companies.
